description: Recursive chaining: a rewrite whose destination matches another rewrite's source. Stage 6e (D-013). Mirrors serve-handler/src/index.js:91-117 'applyRewrites' which removes the matched rule and recurses on the rewritten path. Two rules of the form A→B and B→C; only the final destination file (/c.html) exists. The expected response body is the contents of /c.html, proving that two chained rewrites resolve to a single serve.
